subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and recovery ladder, and which restart, repair, degraded-startup, and notification actions are allowed by default versus explicit opt-in?
rationale: The remaining work crosses product scope, config compatibility, operator authority, security boundaries, and upgrade behavior, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent policy.

options.title: Keep design umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to drive a maintainer-approved core design and review narrower PRs such as the rescue watchdog, health schema, doctor repair, and crash ladder against that design.

options.title: Split into canonical slices
options.body: Keep only narrower issues or PRs open for each remaining slice after the broad security and product requirements are copied into them.

options.title: Reject core recovery ownership
options.body: Document the supported external-supervisor or plugin pattern and close the core request if maintainers decide recovery should stay outside OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Keep design umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to drive a maintainer-approved core design and review narrower PRs such as the rescue watchdog, health schema, doctor repair, and crash ladder against that design.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the Gateway health, unhandled-error, docs, config, and security policy surfaces where steipete has the strongest recent history and product-boundary signal.
